symptom: Newly created empty portfolio dashboard/holdings returned 503 without snapshot
root_cause: Creation lifecycle did not prepare portfolio-scoped dashboard read model; snapshot GET resolved MAIN from worker context instead of the validated request header
reproduction: Create empty portfolio after MAIN contains positions; dashboard snapshot read could resolve MAIN payload
fix: Prepare snapshot during creation and scope dashboard/holdings snapshot GETs from validated X-Portfolio-Id

symptom: History-boundary monkeypatch leaked into later requests in full-suite order
root_cause: Mock patched proxy instance method and retained stale bound method beyond teardown
reproduction: Run history-boundary read-model test before full suite
fix: Patch underlying repository factory class method and restore it through pytest monkeypatch

symptom: Non-deterministic duplicate/private-asset test failures from previous pytest database contents
root_cause: Test DB filename used only process ID and survived termination; Windows PID reuse reopened stale DB
reproduction: Fresh pytest process can reuse previous income-analytics-pytest-<pid>.db
regression_test: test run database is now a UUID-named per-run file via tests/conftest.py
